data.title: About David
bio: Hello!  I would like to introduce myself.  My name is David McCall and I have lived in Old Bridge, New Jersey for the past 21 years.

I am married to my beautiful wife for 17 years and am a stepfather to twin boys and one girl and have five amazing grandchildren, four girls and one boy.  I have been involved in buying and selling real estate for more than 10 years.  I specialize in commercial real estate but I can help in selling your home and buying a new one.
